title: MCP Server Module
summary: This module provides components for implementing and interacting with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, including HTTP-based server implementations, configuration loading, and data models for MCP entities like resources and prompts.

nodes.label: MCP Client
nodes.title: External MCP Client
nodes.description: An external client application that communicates with the MCP server to send requests and receive responses.

nodes.label: Configuration File
nodes.title: MCP Configuration File
nodes.description: A JSON configuration file specifying MCP server definitions and their properties, often including environment variable expansion.

nodes.label: LLM Model
nodes.title: Language Model
nodes.description: The underlying Large Language Model used by the MCP server to generate responses to client requests.

nodes.label: Agent Framework
nodes.title: Agent Framework Module
nodes.description: The module responsible for defining and managing agents, which can utilize MCP toolsets loaded by this module.

nodes.label: Capabilities & Tools
nodes.title: Capabilities and Tools Module
nodes.description: Defines various capabilities and toolsets, including the MCPToolset which is instantiated by this module.

nodes.label: Model Abstraction
nodes.title: Model Abstraction Module
nodes.description: Provides abstractions for interacting with LLMs, including model request functions and settings used by the MCP server handler.

nodes.label: HTTP MCP Server
nodes.title: MCPServerHTTP
nodes.description: Implements a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server over HTTP using Server-Sent Events (SSE). Note: This class is deprecated.

nodes.label: Handle MCP Request
nodes.title: MCP Request Handler
nodes.description: Processes incoming MCP sampling messages, maps them to internal PydanticAI messages, applies model settings, and orchestrates LLM interaction to generate responses.

nodes.label: Load MCP Toolsets
nodes.title: load_mcp_toolsets
nodes.description: Reads a configuration file to instantiate and return a list of MCPToolset objects, often wrapped with prefixes for disambiguation. Supports environment variable expansion.

nodes.label: Load MCP Server Configs
nodes.title: load_mcp_servers
nodes.description: Parses a configuration file to load definitions for various MCP server types (Stdio, HTTP, Streamable HTTP), expanding environment variables as needed. Note: This function is deprecated.

nodes.label: MCP Resource Model
nodes.title: Resource
nodes.description: Pydantic model representing a discoverable resource on an MCP server, including its URI, size, MIME type, and metadata.

nodes.label: MCP Resource Template Model
nodes.title: ResourceTemplate
nodes.description: Pydantic model defining a template for parameterized resources on an MCP server, using a URI template for construction.

nodes.label: MCP Prompt Model
nodes.title: Prompt
nodes.description: Pydantic model representing a prompt or prompt template offered by an MCP server, including its name, title, description, arguments, and icons.

nodes.label: MCP Resource Link Model
nodes.title: ResourceLink
nodes.description: Pydantic model representing a reference to a resource, typically used in prompt or tool call results, without embedding the content directly.

groups.label: MCP Server Interface
groups.title: MCP Server Interface Components
groups.description: Components responsible for exposing and handling the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server interface.

groups.label: Configuration Management
groups.title: MCP Configuration Management
groups.description: Functions for loading and processing MCP server and toolset configurations from external files.

groups.label: MCP Data Structures
groups.title: Model Context Protocol Data Structures
groups.description: Pydantic models defining the structure of various entities within the Model Context Protocol, such as resources, templates, prompts, and resource links.
